features.note: Counter-rotation now reads from surfaces, not just silhouette: the drive blade sweeps up with a bright streaked face while the bottom blade counter-tilts and catches a distinct cool reflective strip along its opposite-facing skin; the top blade tilts into a readable dark underside instead of a void. Never parallel at 30% travel.

Unchanged and strong: plated stub protrudes ~40-50 mm from a boss on the frame right face before the black clamp; the orange body hangs offset on the shaft, never flush. Anti-rotation strap descends to a strap foot with a legible plated hex bolt and washer on the frame face.

Off-white indicator disc with a bold dark pointer sits on the actuator head on the shaft axis, angled consistently with 30% travel. Printed 0-90 arc remains deferred to the surface pass, not penalized here. No regression.

No regression: channel frame keeps real ~0.13 m depth, flange rings on both faces with discrete fastener heads and visible wall thickness at the opening. Flange top faces carry the cool sky-gradient sheen that anchors the galvanized family.

Carried correction APPLIED: the middle (drive-blade) crank block now tilts opposed to the top and bottom cranks, which share one arm angle — mirroring matches the +theta/-theta/+theta blade signs. Bright plated tie rod links all three; unequal block spacing betrays articulation. Kinematics now read coherent from this view.

important_features.note: Blade-edge EPDM bulbs read as discrete matte near-black strips along the blade long edges with correct rubber flatness. Lower jamb strips now separate from the frame interior with a readable edge; the upper interior jamb is still dim and its seal only faintly distinct — improved but not fully resolved.
Clean light rectangular label plate on the orange front face at plausible proportions; printed spec text remains a surface-pass item, not penalized. Unchanged.

Dark cable exits below the actuator and droops with a verifiable curved bend to the floor beside the CONTROL DE EQUIPO panel — a catenary, not a rod. Still dim against the dark floor and partially clipped by the UI panel, but legible.

defects: Drive blade sits roughly one value family brighter than the frame that shares galv_steel; plausible as the light-catching face, but the environment reflection on it is a single soft low-frequency dark band rather than structured room content.
Roughness variation (streaking/mottling) is clear on the blade skin but the frame's flat faces remain fairly uniform; only the flange tops break uniformity via the sky gradient.
Upper interior of the opening is still the darkest zone: the top blade underside and upper jamb seal separate from shadow only marginally.

Single-view ambiguity (recorded per gate contract): the galvanized read is verified only from this one neutral view; no grazing/look-dev capture was provided to confirm the metal response under a second light angle.
corrections: Optional polish for the lighting-camera pass: add a faint secondary fill or slightly higher env intensity on the upper interior so the top blade underside and upper jamb seal read without inspection.
Optional polish: extend the streak/mottle roughness variation from the blade skin onto the frame's flat faces at lower amplitude so no galvanized plane is perfectly uniform.
